content.title: Sole Proprietorship: The Most Common Structure for Small Businesses
content.content:
A sole proprietorship is a business owned and operated by one individual. This structure offers several advantages, including simplicity, low costs, and flexibility. However, it also comes with significant disadvantages, such as unlimited personal liability and limited access to capital.
